stemMd: If p is even and q is odd, which expression must be odd?
explanationMd: An even integer squared remains even and an odd integer squared remains odd. Their sum is odd. Each alternative includes an even product or adds two odd contributions.

distractorRationale.a: Even plus odd plus one is even.
distractorRationale.d: Even plus odd plus one is even.
distractorRationale.e: A product containing an even factor is even.
